scope: Isolated existing ggml indexed/scatter Q8_1 APIs; no production dispatch or full-model A/B
benchmark_scope: Warm allocations, same source bytes, 5 alternating-order paired CUDA-event samples of 20 launches; no maps/allocation/copy/model time

thermal_assessment.note: Sampled reasons alone do not establish clock stability, sustained state or matched A/B conditions

decision: Defer integration: quantizer GPU time is only 0.638% of traced 2K prefill, includes unshareable down inputs, and full-route scatter does not fit current W-row buffer without a resource redesign. IQ2_XS exact-one CPU comparison and CPU/PCIe completion ledger remain next candidates.
